---
title: "5: How Cases Reach Courts -- Legal Mobilization"
---

Under what conditions do individuals and interest groups resort to litigation and what makes their success likely? As "passive" institutions, courts rely on legal mobilization for influence. This week we explore the dynamics of legal mobilization, the role of resources and lawyers, and who tends to come out ahead.
